controls.label: Level
controls.hint: Where the crowd is: a market square with alleys behind the houses, a castle with ramps up to its walls, or a hedge maze with more than one way through.

controls.label: Crowd size
controls.hint: How many people are on the level.

controls.label: Speed
controls.hint: How fast they go when you send them: a brisk walk at the low end, a sprint at the high end.

controls.label: Show walkable area
controls.hint: Draws the navmesh: the floor Recast worked out from the level, which re-cuts around every block you drop.

controls.label: Personal space
controls.hint: How hard people keep apart from each other. At 0 they brush past; at 4 they give each other room.

controls.label: Mill about
controls.hint: Whether people walk on their own: round the level until someone sends them, and off for a stroll a few seconds after arriving. Off, they stand.

triggers.label: Scatter
triggers.hint: Everyone runs somewhere of their own.

triggers.label: Clear blocks
triggers.hint: Takes away every stone block you dropped, and the crowd gets those ways back.
